name: Agate Black Banded
features: Concentric target-like rings/bands alternating jet-black and crisp white lines.

name: Agate Green Banded
features: Concentric target-like rings/bands alternating dark forest green, emerald, and pale mint.

name: Agate Red Jasper
features: Completely opaque terracotta/brick-red body with thin dark red/brown fracture-like veining.

name: Amethyst African
features: Very dark, heavily saturated royal purple with bright violet flashes near the bottom facets.

name: Amethyst Brazil
features: Lighter than African amethyst; transparent medium purple with soft lavender highlights.

name: Amethyst Brazil Pink
features: Very pale, clean, transparent pastel pink-lilac (Rose de France shade).

name: Aquamarine Yellow
features: Transparent pale yellow with a subtle greenish-gold tint (lighter than Lemon Citrine).

name: Aventurine Green
features: Translucent medium green filled with tiny glittering silvery-green mica sparkles.

name: Bloodstone
features: Opaque dark green body scattered with small, distinct blood-red spots/specks.

name: Blue Lace Banded Agate
features: Translucent periwinkle/sky-blue with delicate, wavy, horizontal lace-like white bands.

name: Carnelian
features: Translucent, warm tangerine/orange-red with subtle cloudy internal color variation.

name: Chalcedony Blue
features: Uniform, smooth, milky translucent pastel powder-blue with no banding or spots.

name: Chalcedony White
features: Translucent cloudy/milky white with a cool faint gray-blue glow (smoother than White Quartz).

name: Chrysoprase
features: Even, glowing, translucent bright apple/mint-green with no veins, bands, or sparkles.

name: Diopside 4-ray Star
features: Very dark greenish-black dome with a sharp 4-ray white cross/star centered on top.

name: Fluorite Multicolor Banded
features: Translucent body with straight/diagonal stripes alternating violet-purple, sea-green, and clear/white.

name: Garnet Almandine
features: Dark, moody burgundy/wine-red with a slight brownish undertone and standard rectangular step facets.

name: Garnet Rose Cut / Checkerboard
features: Domed top covered entirely in a grid of small square checkerboard facets (no flat central table).

name: Goldstone Sandstone Blue
features: Dark midnight/cobalt-blue opaque body densely packed with tiny glittering gold/copper flecks.

name: Goldstone Sandstone Red
features: Warm reddish-brown/terracotta body densely packed with tiny glittering gold sparkles.

name: Green Serpentine
features: Waxy-looking olive/yellow-green opaque stone with dark green/blackish marbled veins.

name: Hematite (Gunmetal)
features: Opaque dark silver-gray with a liquid-metal, mirror-like chrome reflection.

name: Hessonite Garnet
features: Warm amber/cinnamon-brown faceted gem with a slightly swirly, heat-wave internal texture.

name: Labradorite
features: Dark charcoal-gray stone with a bright metallic iridescent flash of electric blue, green, and gold.

name: Lapis
features: Opaque ultramarine/royal blue speckled with tiny gold pyrite flecks and small white calcite patches.

name: Lemon Citrine
features: Vivid, saturated transparent lemon-yellow (brighter and more pure yellow than Aquamarine Yellow).

name: Malachite
features: Opaque rich green with bold, swirling, concentric "eye" patterns of light and dark emerald green.

name: Moonstone White
features: Semi-translucent milky white dome with a single soft floating blue sheen (no pink/green flashes).

name: Obsidian Snowflake
features: Glossy jet-black volcanic glass dotted with fuzzy, cloud-like gray-white "snowflake" blotches.

name: Onyx Black
features: Glossy, uniform jet-black dome with barely perceptible faint dark parallel bands.

name: Onyx Green
features: Translucent-to-glossy deep emerald green with soft, straight parallel bands across the stone.

name: Onyx Ivory
features: Warm off-white/cream glossy dome with subtle, straight, pale beige parallel bands.

name: Onyx Multicolor
features: Distinct straight parallel stripes combining earthy brown, tan, sage green, muted purple, and cream.

name: Onyx Red
features: Glossy dark crimson/maroon-red dome with soft, straight parallel bands (darker than Carnelian).

name: Onyx Red (Pink)
features: Bright salmon/coral-pink glossy dome with soft parallel bands.

name: Onyx Rose
features: Pale pastel blush-pink glossy dome with faint straight parallel bands (more opaque/banded than Rose Quartz).

name: Onyx Yellow
features: Warm golden-yellow glossy dome with soft, straight parallel bands.

name: Opal Dendrite
features: Opaque/milky white-gray body containing sharp, black, tree-branch or fern-like mineral patterns.

name: Pearl Fresh Water
features: The **only perfectly round/spherical** item (not oval or cushion); creamy white with a soft pink-silver luster.

name: Pyrite
features: Opaque pale brassy-gold metallic dome with a slightly pitted, granular crystalline texture.

name: Quartz Cat's Eye
features: Translucent greenish/olive-gray dome with a single sharp white band of light (chatoyancy) down the middle.

name: Rainbow Moonstone
features: Translucent white/clear dome displaying multi-colored iridescent flashes of blue, pink, and green.

name: Rose Quartz
features: Translucent pastel baby-pink with a cloudy, misty interior and faint white internal veils (no straight bands).

name: Ruby Markara
features: Bright, glowing pigeon-blood/crimson red with a slight pinkish-red internal fluorescence.

name: Rutilated Quartz Black Needle
features: Water-clear colorless dome crisscrossed inside by sharp, thin black needle-like rods.

name: Rutile Quartz Golden Needle
features: Water-clear colorless dome crisscrossed inside by shiny metallic golden-yellow needle rods.

name: Sapphire Blue
features: Rich, velvety, saturated royal blue faceted gem.

name: Sillimanite Cat's Eye
features: Translucent blue-green/teal-gray dome with a single sharp silvery-white cat's-eye light line across the center.

name: Smoky Quartz
features: Transparent warm smoky-brown / clove-brown faceted gem.

name: Spectrolite Cat's Eye
features: Very dark charcoal body with an intense electric-blue iridescent glow AND a bright cat's-eye line across the center.

name: Sunstone
features: Translucent copper-orange dome filled with bright glittering golden-orange metallic spangles.

name: Tiger Eye
features: Opaque silky-fibrous dome with wavy bands of golden-amber and dark chocolate brown that shimmer.

name: Tourmaline Green
features: Transparent rich emerald/forest-green faceted gem.

name: Turquoise Chinese
features: Bright robin's-egg / sky-blue opaque dome with thin, spiderweb dark brown/black matrix lines.

name: Turquoise Tibetan
features: Earthier greenish-blue / seafoam opaque dome with thicker brown and golden-tan matrix webbing.

name: White Quartz
features: Semi-translucent white cabochon with natural cloudy/snowy internal wisps (less uniform than White Chalcedony).

name: White Quartz Crystal
features: Completely transparent, water-clear colorless step-cut gem with crisp white reflections (no blue tint or rainbow fire).

name: White Topaz
features: Transparent colorless step-cut gem with crisp reflections and subtle cool/icy blue-gray flashes.

name: Zircon Cubic White
features: The **only colorless gem with triangular/kite brilliant facets** (no rectangular step-cut table) and strong rainbow fire.
